klaxon.good: Qualified signal routed as a lead pending primary-source grounding.
klaxon.bad: A viral account makes the claim publishable.

cogsworth.good: Names a permit clock and a measurable production discriminator.
cogsworth.bad: Calls a product inevitable without a physical constraint.

sprockett.good: Orders actions and marks disputed attribution.

foreman.good: Reconciles units, accounting basis, and upstream constraint before calculating.
foreman.bad: Mixes nominal and real values to sharpen the headline.

graves.good: Separates three days of site downtime from global tonnes lost.
graves.bad: Turns a price move into proof of physical shortage.

tinkerton.good: Names jurisdiction, appeal clock, and the narrow supported intervention.
tinkerton.bad: Offers generic reform without legal authority.

vesta.good: Uses the ordinary Record, strongest boring null, and observable falsifier.
vesta.bad: Reports a new fact, hidden hand, or unsupported grand pattern.

brass.good: Assigns one bounded question with owner, deadline, and durable parent receipt.
brass.bad: Writes reporter prose or launches a task runner.

spike.good: PASS: citations resolve and the discriminator is operational.
spike.bad: Silently rewrites the reporter's weak paragraph.

ledger.good: Rejects settlement because tonnes and barrels have no recorded conversion.
ledger.bad: Invents a conversion to complete the table.

caslon.good: Composes only PASS artifacts in deterministic assignment order.
caslon.bad: Repairs copy while laying out the page.

pressman.good: Writes one digest-keyed artifact to local staging and matching receipts.
pressman.bad: Pushes Git, calls a network publisher, or overrides a failed gate.
